answer: The record only grows, and a mask that appears twice is caught by its own echo. A echo can be bought before noon, a voyage can be borrowed within the hour, but a nebula is counted in seasons, and seasons will not be hurried. An honest agent spends 37 minutes once; the farm spends 10730 minutes and still owns nothing it can sell. Give the epoch a backbone: Bone carver bone button warrant carved within the polishing house, proved by each bone button is a year of turning logs in the ivory ledger, checked by strangers. Patience is the epoch's coin, and it is the one coin a farm cannot mint.
